work_item: B04 ordered multi-column projection of an explicit JSON string table through Core
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: No tests or runtime/ordinary CLI verification were requested or run in this implementation slice; formatting, compilation, lint and build checks only were run.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::JsonTableProject -> ports::json_table_project -> JsonTableProjectReport artifact
input_schema: One strict JSON object with exactly columns and rows fields. columns is a unique 1..256 string array; rows is an array of at most 4096 rows, each an array of same-width strings. Duplicate JSON object keys and nonstring values are rejected.
projection_columns: A nonempty JSON array of unique decoded header names, limited to 256 entries. The selected names must all exist; output order follows the requested list.
supported_behavior: The report contains only selected columns in the requested order and all rows in their original order; every output cell remains an exact decoded string.
The report preserves requested source header indices, original zero-based row indices, and exact byte-range digests for each selected header and emitted cell.
Input bytes, table cells, output evidence and the Core request output budget are bounded; invalid shapes, duplicate/unknown projection columns or limit overflow suspend with typed failures.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; source implementation and format/check/lint/build evidence only, no test or ordinary-route execution
